title: Soulflare Totem
description: Item to revive your friends on hardcore in minecraft
body:
Soulflare totem

Item to revive your friends on hardcore in minecraft
See releases · Report Bug · Request Feature

### Obtaining --- ### Usage --- Just throw the totem on ground and let your friend in spectator interract with it. ### Installation --- Put **datapack zip into datapack folder in your world**. And if you want special texture for the totem just install a resource pack. This project is **server side**, so datapack should be installeed only on host/server, but **texture pack can be installed only on clients**
